truth_yaml_said.x-notes: Response is {invoices:[], total:N} object, not a bare array. total is authoritative count. List items are lightweight — single item is much richer.

live_probe_result.description: GET page=999 page_size=50 — forces empty page to verify wrapper shape on zero-result page
live_probe_result.total_is_authoritative: total=0 on empty page means workspace currently has 0 invoices (or prior cleanup removed them all)

notes: TRUTH.yaml says response is {invoices:[], total:N} wrapper object, not a bare array. Confirmed live — page 999 returns the wrapper with total:0 and empty invoices array. The wrapper shape holds even on empty pages. TRUTH.yaml's status enum [DRAFT, SENT, UNSENT, OVERDUE, PAID, VOID] not re-tested here but was not the focus of this devil probe. Minor note: the MCP layer adds has_more to meta but TRUTH.yaml does not document has_more on this endpoint — this is a MCP augmentation, not a Clockify API field.
